text.tspan: "The driver, a vehicle occupant, needs to see on the HMI display what the driving application perceives beside the vehicle speed, to get the collision warning on the display and as a sound, and to see the speed and the warning, or the fact that the warning is unavailable, also while Android in the IVI VM hangs, boots or restarts."

"The vehicle drives with the candidate active in a scenario of the driver-assistance increment: the candidate gives its scene and, when it decides on a warning, its warning request, and the vehicle gives its speed; at times the app that draws the scene ends or hangs, Android in the IVI VM boots, hangs or restarts, or the warning request stops reaching the display."

"The display shows the scene as the candidate gives it and the speed, gives the collision warning on the display and as a sound when the warning request arrives, shows no element as current when it is not, and keeps the speed and the warning, or the fact that the warning is unavailable, apparent while the app that draws the scene or Android in the IVI VM is out or the warning request stops reaching the display."
Operate the HMI display without selecting the realization of an
element or of a path, and without any human-factors, safety, on-road,
